name: Shanghai FourSemi Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai FourSemi Semiconductor Co., Ltd., incorporated in 2016, supplies perceptual-intelligence chips in China. Its product families cover low-power and higher-power audio chips, automotive audio, haptic drivers, power management and sensor chips, aimed at the automotive, consumer and industrial control markets. It also develops and distributes integrated circuits and was formerly Xiamen FourSemi Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
